questions.question: Explain how the structure of the mitochondria enables efficient aerobic respiration

points.text: Double membrane: outer permeable, inner folded into cristae (large SA for ETC). Matrix contains Krebs cycle enzymes. Intermembrane space accumulates H⁺ for chemiosmosis. Own DNA/ribosomes for some ETC proteins
